### wdotool keys explain yz@ 2>&1
layout: English (US) -- group 1 of 1, from wayland
level keys: shift = key 42 <LFSH>   level3 = none   level5 = none   (what wdotool presses)
note: this layout is plain US: wdotool uses its built-in table and never reads the keymap
'y' -- 1 press on English (US)
    press key 21 <AD06> -> 'y'
    wdotool key 29                             (keycodes)
    wdotool type 'y'                           (characters)
'z' -- 1 press on English (US)
    press key 44 <AB01> -> 'z'
    wdotool key 52                             (keycodes)
    wdotool type 'z'                           (characters)
'@' -- 1 press on English (US)
    press key 3 <AE02> with shift (key 42 <LFSH>, Shift_L) -> '@'
    wdotool key 50+11                          (keycodes)
    wdotool type '@'                           (characters)
